about.title: MEET JOSHUA
about.description: My name is Joshua Maurizio and for over 10 years I have been working as a personal trainer in some of the most renowned gyms in Italy (Virgin Active, Hard Candy, Audace Palestre, FitActive, FitExpress, Allenamento Funzionale Milano). I am certified AIPT (ASI-CONI) and Burningate, with specializations in natural bodybuilding, functional training, weight loss, postural and calisthenics. I love accompanying people on a journey of concrete change, through personalized training adapted to every need.

sections.title: My beginning
sections.content: At 18, I decided to change my life and dedicate myself to fitness. A journey made of commitment, discipline and the desire to become my best version.

sections.title: Consistency and determination
sections.content: I continue my fitness journey with consistency and determination, also supported by a nutritionist. A path of balance between training, nutrition and personal growth.

sections.title: Gym and discipline
sections.content: I train in the gym with dedication to build strength, discipline and well-being. Every day a step forward towards my goals.

sections.title: Discovery of Calisthenics
sections.content: I practice Calisthenics to develop strength, body control and agility. Consistent training and passion to overcome my limits every day.

sections.title: Training with friends
sections.content: I practice Calisthenics in the park with friends, combining training and fun. Every session is an opportunity to grow, improve and meet new passionate people.

sections.title: Continuous improvement
sections.content: I constantly improve thanks to well-programmed Calisthenics workouts and the support of a quality nutritionist. A studied path to maximize results, strength and well-being.

sections.title: Couple fitness
sections.content: I share my passion for fitness with my soulmate, between workouts and growing together. A journey of strength, motivation and fun shared day after day.

sections.title: New collaboration
sections.content: I start a new work collaboration with my partner, combining professionalism and harmony. Together we transform ideas into concrete projects, with passion and determination.

sections.title: Personal trainer - Weight training
sections.content: After years of weight training and working as a personal trainer, I have transformed my passion into concrete experience. Today I combine competence and dedication to help others achieve their goals.

sections.title: Personal trainer - Calisthenics
sections.content: After years of Calisthenics and experience as a personal trainer, I have transformed passion into competence. Today I help others grow and achieve their goals with method and dedication.

sections.title: Experience and knowledge
sections.content: After years of fitness studies and training of all kinds, I have transformed passion into concrete experience. Today I combine knowledge and practice to obtain effective and lasting results.

coaching.lead: A training program built around you, to follow at the gym, at home or in the park: I coach you remotely through your personal area, exercise videos, regular check-ins and direct contact with me throughout. And if you're in Milan, we can also train together at the gym.

paths.title: Two ways to train with me

online.title: Online coaching
online.text: A tailored program, exercise videos and regular check-ins: train where and when you want, and we stay in touch all the way.

gym.title: At the gym in Milan
gym.text: In-person 1-to-1 sessions, with the right technique exercise by exercise.

steps.title: Free consultation
steps.text: 15 minutes on the phone: tell me your goals, your starting level, the days you have and where you train.

steps.title: Your program
steps.text: I put together a plan made for you, built on the time and equipment you actually have.

steps.title: Train with your personal area
steps.text: Open your area from the link I send you: your training days, a video for every exercise, and you log your weights as you train.

steps.title: I follow you all the way
steps.text: I don't just hand you a plan: we talk about doubts on exercises, loads or the week's setbacks. After the first week and then every two weeks you fill in a short check-in on your progress and, when it's time, I prepare your new plan.

items.title: Personalized plan

items.title: Exercise videos
items.text: The technique of every exercise explained on video, so you train well even on your own.

items.title: Weight log
items.text: Log loads and reps as you train and see your history week after week.

items.title: Regular check-ins
items.text: Energy, sleep, workouts, any discomfort and weight: two minutes to tell me how it is going.

items.title: Always in touch
items.text: A doubt about an exercise or the loads? Message me and we talk: you're never on your own. And when it's time, your new plan is right there in your area.

items.title: No app to install
items.text: Your personal area opens in the browser, on phone and computer.

why.title: Who coaches you
why.text: I'm Joshua Maurizio, a personal trainer for over 10 years. Certified AIPT (ASI-CONI) and Burningate, I specialize in natural bodybuilding, calisthenics, weight loss and posture.

gym.title: Prefer to train in person?
gym.text: If you're in Milan we can train together at the gym: I coach you in person, correct your technique on the spot and build the program step by step.
gym.imageAlt: 1-to-1 training at the gym in Milan

items.q: Do I have to train at a gym?
items.a: No. The program is built around where you train: gym, home or park, with the equipment you have.

items.q: I'm a beginner: is that OK?
items.a: Yes. We start from your level: the videos show you the technique of every exercise, the check-ins tell me how you are doing and we talk whenever you have a doubt.
It depends on the length of the program and your goals: we talk about it in the free consultation, no strings attached.

items.q: How does the free consultation work?
items.a: Pick a day and time from the calendar below: a 15-minute call to see together whether online coaching is right for you.

items.q: I live in Milan: can we also train at the gym?
items.a: Yes: besides online coaching I run 1-to-1 sessions at a gym in Milan. We can talk about it in the consultation.
